title: Field-aware invert of a prior leave-gap TrimClip command
aggregateCanonical: sha256 of sorted "digest  path\n" lines of sourceSha256
bounds: Field-aware invert of a prior non-tip leave-gap TrimClip command restores only that command's trim write set (the shortened remnant's recorded range leaves and the added gap filler) when those fields still match the command's after-image. A later unrelated SetMarkers does not conflict: invert restores the pre-trim duration, removes the filler, and keeps the later markers and unmoved cues. On a video-only timeline, a later leave-gap move of a non-adjacent remnant also does not conflict and keeps already-followed cues.

A later out-trim that changes a recorded duration numerator, a later leave-gap move of an adjacent remnant, or invert of the tip, is whole-group UNDO_CONFLICT and does not roll the database back. After extract, a later same-track MoveClip may remint the leave-gap filler and also conflict; official workbench path extracts only so the Trim button is leave-gap, then uses a later marker rather than a move. Official InversePatch kind stays restoreSnapshot. Linear undo/redo stay tip snapshot restores. Leaf-level rational n/d granularity is unchanged. Video and caption mute/solo stay refused at admission with FEATURE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED. Audio muted/solo stay SetAudioTrackState. syncLock is not toggled. Already-delivered TrimClip, SplitClip, ExtractAudioClip, UnlinkAudioVideo / LinkAudioVideo, SetAudioTrackState, and SetTrackState locked/unlock semantics stay unchanged. A diverging unlink invert remains LINK_OFFSET_MISMATCH.

A real UI path extracts persistent audio, first splits at 2s, adds left and right cues, splits the left remnant at 1s, leave-gap out-trims the left remnant by 0.5s, adds a later marker, inverts the TrimClip command, then undoes, redoes, archives a fork, and exports a VTT sidecar. Preview and MP4 still refuse CAPTION_RENDER_POLICY_NOT_IMPLEMENTED. The single-clip Move button stays MoveClip.

Already-delivered trim, split, extract, unlink/link, SetAudioTrackState, SetTrackState locked, caption-aware GroupClips/UngroupClips, invert of SetCaptions / SetMarkers / GroupClips / SetTrackState / SetAudioTrackState / UnlinkAudioVideo / ExtractAudioClip / SplitClip, insert-move leave-gap, overwrite, LiftClips/Cut, caption default/follow/interval/source-window, marker absolute default / clipLocal follow / ripple interval, 1000 seeded random undo, and the opened section-3 geometry matrix stay unchanged. Auto-close-on-move, new-track, cross-project bake, OS clipboard, source-interval crop, marker sidecar formats, a complete invert matrix, I-006, MP4 burn-in, and the table's 0.02s off-grid offset are not in this slice. Lifting a clipLocal-marker host remains REF_NOT_FOUND. An uncovering or cropping interval remains ANCHOR_OUT_OF_RANGE.
